_doc: Every kanji word on the site with its meaning, by drawing style (mincho: Shippori Mincho B1 ExtraBold, brush: Yuji Boku). Words are drawn as SVG from src/generated/kanji-glyphs.json; the build fails on a word missing here. After adding one run scripts/landing/kanji.py.

mincho.柔: ju, gentle, supple (the first half of judo)
mincho.七転八起: nanakorobi yaoki, "fall seven times, get up eight"
mincho.受: uke, to receive (as in ukemi, breakfalls)
mincho.一本: ippon, a full point, the winning score
